How to Win

Roll 1 or 6 to release a marble. Travel clockwise around the black U-shaped tracks. Land on a rival to send their marble back to BASE. Enter your own colored HOME lane after circling the board. Get all your marbles into HOME to win.
Marble Summit is an independent classroom-friendly marble race with original artwork and traditional-style rules.
MARBLE SUMMIT

Set Up Your Race

Six colored arms and six seats, with four marbles per player by default. Choose humans or computer opponents and customize each team's swirled marbles.

GAME GUIDE

How to Play

BASE: Each of the six arms ends in a tray with four starting marbles. Roll 1 or 6 to send a marble directly to your matching START dimple.

Track: Move clockwise around all six colored U-shaped tracks. You can jump over opposing marbles but cannot pass or land on your own. Landing on an opponent returns them to BASE.

HOME: Your HOME ENTRY is on the other side of the colored arm from START. Travel nearly the full outer circuit until your own HOME ENTRY, then turn inward into the four HOME dimples. You must count your roll exactly and cannot jump your own marbles in HOME.

Die: A 6 earns an extra turn by default; turn this off in setup if desired. There are no shortcut rings or center shortcuts in this edition. The printed center design is decorative.

Controls: After rolling, click a highlighted marble, then a highlighted destination. Or use the move list. Computer opponents have three skill settings and five different playing styles. Undo restores the last completed move. Your game autosaves to this browser.
